mapper.sql: id, route_id, uri, order_no, enabled, predicates_json, filters_json, metadata_json, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_config (route_id, uri, order_no, enabled, predicates_json, filters_json, metadata_json, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{routeId}, #{uri}, #{orderNo}, #{enabled}, #{predicatesJson}, #{filtersJson}, #{metadataJson}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE route_config SET uri = #{uri}, order_no = #{orderNo}, enabled = #{enabled}, predicates_json = #{predicatesJson}, filters_json = #{filtersJson}, metadata_json = #{metadataJson}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM route_config WHERE route_id = #{routeId}
SELECT FROM route_config ORDER BY order_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM route_config WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY order_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM route_config WHERE LOWER(route_id) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(uri) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY order_no ASC, id ASC
